intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle holds a waterproof letter in each hand, just above the waterline.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “The shore families want the marker buoys moved further out. The offshore families want them moved further in.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “The same buoys. Both letters end, ‘as the princess will surely agree.’”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Inconveniently, I agree with half of each.”

options.labelText: “Talk me through it. I’ll be the wall you bounce it off.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “A wall. How refreshing. Everyone else offers to be a second sovereign.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She starts reading aloud. By the third paragraph, she is arguing with both letters, and winning.

options.labelText: “Do the shore one first. The offshore lot are further out, so they’ll complain slower.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “They complain at exactly the same speed. It arrives wetter.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She moves the offshore letter to the top.

options.labelText: “Ditch the ocean court. I’m a better use of your time.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Those are families, {PLAYER}. Not a hobby I can put down.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She turns her back to answer them. Both letters get a reply before you get another word.
